business: Asian Paints manufactures and sells paints, coatings, and home decor products. Segments include decorative coatings, international business, and home improvement offerings.
bull: Full year FY26 revenue returned to positive growth of 4.9% with an annual revenue of Rs 35,584 crore.
FY26 EBITDA margin achieved 19.0%, staying squarely inside the guided 18-20% band.
Strong top-line expansion in Q1 FY27 with consolidated revenue growing by 18% YoY to Rs 10,542 crore.
bear: Standalone volume growth slowed to 6.4% in Q2 FY27, trailing earlier full-year volume ambitions.
Borrowings increased over the last three balance sheets from Rs 2,290 crore to Rs 4,596 crore.
Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin dropped to 15.6%, missing the typical 18-20% guidance band for that quarter.
